messages:
nina: Planning cross-service rollout tonight. Sequence proposed: runtime 2.6.0 -> api 1.11.0 -> router 4.4. Console schema change pinned behind feature-flag. Window 00:30-01:30 UTC. Thoughts?
omar: Fine with sequence. Two operational asks: 1) explicit pin/unpin commands in thread, 2) a short rollback script snippet for on-call.
claire: Agree. Also we need a tight canary plan for the api header flip (x-rdwd-new). Console must not flip until router confirms header passthrough for 10m.
deploy-bot: received: deploy(runtime@2.6.0, api@1.11.0[ff:header_new], router@4.4) scheduled 00:30 UTC. Running preflight checks... :robot_face:
ops-watch: Preflight: infra capacity nominal, but scheduler reports one noisy host (high swap) -- avoid pinning too many pods to it. Recommend 5% canary baseline.
nina: Canary cadence: runtime quick canary 5% for 5m, then API canary 5% for 10m (FF on), then api ramp to 30% for 10m, then router. Halt triggers: api or router 5xx >1.5% sustained or p95 +220ms vs baseline for 10m.
omar: Add console error trigger: console/schema-errors >0.4% OR console validation task failing -> immediate FF kill and hold.
claire: Rollback snippets to paste to ops:
```
# rollback api to previous
deploy-bot rollback api@1.11.0 -> api@1.10.5
# rollback runtime
kubectl -n runtime set image deploy/runtime runtime=runtime:2.5.9
# unpin sequence if runtime error
deploy-bot unpin api
deploy-bot unpin router
```
deploy-runner: post-deploy hook will run schema-verify and smoke-e2e. If schema-verify fails, deploy-bot will auto-queue rollback.
ops-watch: I'll seed dashboards: api/header-latency, api/5xx, router/retry-rate, runtime/kv-evict, console/schema-errors. Will add a synthetic check hitting header path.
nina: Tracing: enable 100% sampling for /v1/* for the first 20m of api canary. Route traces to #eng-trace.
omar: Tests note: staging showed a header-merge edge when multiple header entries present; 1.11.0 normalizes but watch logs: api.header.normalize.warn. Add alert >20/min.
claire: Emergency playbook: if runtime fails catastrophically (node-level kernel OOM or kv-evict storms), unpin api/router and rollback runtime. If api canary acts up, kill FF immediately, rollback api, and keep runtime pinned while we investigate.
deploy-bot: preflight results: images signed, smoke tests passed for runtime and api, router smoke queued.
nina: Release notes draft (short): "runtime: KV cache and eviction tuning; api: header normalization + contract change (opt-in via FF); router: backpressure smoothing; console: staged schema migration (FF-controlled)."
omar: Oncall: ops-watch (primary), claire (secondary). PagerDuty configured for api-route and router-slo.
claire: OK. We start at 00:30 UTC. Keep all live signals here and call rollback if any of the thresholds hit.
ops-watch: I'll be in the window, watching dashboards and will post minute-by-minute quick updates.
deploy-bot: deploying at 00:30 UTC. Good luck!
nina: Thanks team. See you in the window.
